messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT — elevated 5xxs observed on api-gateway (eu-west-1). 502/504 spike, error rate ≈15% (baseline 0.3%). Paging @sasha (oncall).

sasha: I'm on it, joining call now. pulling dashboards.

mijan: Seen it — sharp jump at 2026-03-17T15:12Z. edge->mux 502s and mux->infer 504s. kv-cache hit-rate dropped from ~90% -> ~30% around same time.

arun: quick check: recent model rollout to redwood-infer-eu-3 at 15:10 UTC. possible incompat with cache key format?

sasha: ok rolling back the canary to v1.2.3 now (manual rollback). ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: canary -> v1.2.3 (action id rb-8921).

mijan: initiating regional fallback: shift 10% traffic -> eu-central for embeddings route to reduce pressure on eu-west.

lisa-support: customer-impact: 12 incoming tickets referencing 502s on /v1/embeddings and elevated latency. Posting banner to status page now.

tom-product: Notifying top affected customers via account SRE list. If this runs >30m we'll escalate to Exec comms.

sasha: Rollback finished. immediate drop in 502s from 15% -> 0.8% in first 90s. after traffic shift steady at ~0.2%.

mijan: capturing logs for RCA. sample: 
```
[2026-03-17T15:12:34Z] infer: upstream response 504, conn reset by peer, model=redwood-opt-q4-v2, kv_key_lookup=miss
[2026-03-17T15:12:35Z] mux: rate-limited downstream connections, error=502, pool=redwood-infer-eu-3
```

arun: hypothesis: model variant changed serialization of prefix -> cache keys, causing massive kv misses, backend replication thrash -> transient overload and timeouts.

mijan: mitigation steps: 1) rollback (done), 2) traffic shift (done), 3) temp raise mux connection limit and enable short-term retry backoff. I'll apply the mux limit tweak and monitor.

sasha: applied mux limit bump + soft retry backoff. observing tail latency and error rate.

lisa-support: monitoring customer threads, posting update to status page: "Degraded — partial outage mitigated, service recovering".

tom-product: good. please add list of affected customers to the incident doc. cc @sales & @acct-sre.

sasha: leaving monitoring window. Handoff to night oncall @arun at 16:00 UTC. I'll remain available for 15m as backup.

arun: ack, taking over monitoring for 30m. will own postmortem and RCA.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: sev=2, start=2765432101, mitigation at 2765432119. Postmortem owner=arun. Created follow-up tasks in #postmortems and pinged page-followups.
